title: Usual module pullback commutes with tensor powers
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], M an O_Y-module and m a natural number. For the usual module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], f*(M^{⊗m}) is isomorphic to (f*M)^{⊗m}, including m=0. No compatibility with a specified section map is asserted.

source.place: Modules Tag 01CD, iterated for tensor powers; existing source proof in WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/ProjectionFormula.lean:73

proof.text: Use the monoidal unit comparison pullbackObjUnitIso for m=0. For m+1 compose the proved monoidal binary comparison (Functor.Monoidal.μIso).symm with the identity on f*M tensored with the induction isomorphism. This is exactly the existing proof of nonempty_pullback_tensorPow_iso in ProjectionFormula.lean.
